edits.new: none asserts that an appraisal is stale, that an order leaves or that a rule fires. The messages the criteria name, MSG-P4-002 and MSG-GEN-001, are served from the catalogues of their owning services; the story adds no message of its own.

edits.new:
And no event is published, because the ownership rows give S1 none, and no Schedule is declared

  Scenario: C8 Every business rule of the baseline holds (new, D-RCV-60)
    Given the business rules table of section 8
    When each of BR1 to BR9 is checked against the baseline document
    Then BR1 to BR9 each hold, and each is checked by a test named in section 16 or by a guardrail or boundary test

  Scenario: C9 A retried or timed-out activity of the route workflow is handled as declared (new, D-RCV-60)
    Given RouteDecisionWorkflow and its two activities as declared in the baseline
    When a consumed row exceeds its 2 s budget or an activity is retried
    Then the activity reports a failure from the error set of C5
    And the retry and the timeout follow the values the workflow table names

  Scenario: C10 A status change the model does not allow is refused (new, D-RCV-60)
    Given the closed lists and the status model of the baseline
    When a change requests a status transition the model does not allow
    Then the request is refused with an error from the error set of C5
    And no change is made
